title: Aquarius, the safest distance
caption: loving everyone from orbit, as usual

scenes.text: aquarius, come in for a landing.
you think in centuries and forget to eat lunch.
uranus gave you lightning and a very long view.
you can love the whole world from up there.
it's one person, up close, that feels like weather.
so you go quiet, and you call it independence.
sometimes it's just the safest distance.
you don't have to become ordinary to be close.
your strange parts are the ones worth reading.
find the one who leans in when you get strange,
and lean back. that's the whole experiment.
the future has room for one more.
